name: graph
title: Graph — talk in diagrams
description: A dark-violet node/edge board. Draw flows and ideas; the companion and Claude read the same graph and answer by editing it.

graph.changed.summary: The graph changed (debounced 400 ms): {rev, summary:{nodes,edges}, diff:{added,removed,updated}}

graph.node.select.summary: The human's node selection changed (debounced 150 ms): {ids, labels}

graph.node.update.summary: The human edited or moved a node: {id, patch}

graph.export.summary: "Send to Claude": the full graph for review: {graph}

graph.ask.summary: "Ask": a question about the selection: {question, selection, graph}

graph.snapshot.summary: Answer to the graph.snapshot command (re = command id): {graph}

graph.load.summary: Replace (or merge:true) the board with a graph; nodes without x/y are auto-placed

graph.node.add.summary: Add a node; placed near `near` or the view centre without overlap when x/y are omitted

graph.node.set.summary: Patch a node: {id, patch:{label?, kind?, x?, y?, w?, h?, color?, text?, image?, meta?}}

graph.node.remove.summary: Remove nodes (and their edges and annotations): {ids}

graph.edge.add.summary: Connect two nodes: {from, to, label?, id?, kind?}; an existing from→to edge is updated

graph.focus.summary: Pan/zoom to fit the given node or edge ids (all when empty): {ids}

graph.highlight.summary: Pulse a glow on nodes/edges: {ids, color?, ttl?}; ttl 0 keeps it, empty ids clears

graph.annotate.summary: Attach (or update, or with empty text remove) a sticky note on a node: {id, text}

graph.snapshot.summary: Ask the board for its full graph; it replies with a graph.snapshot event
